title: 電波裡的你
subject: a radio station that went off air
caption: Synthpop in Mandarin. Analog synth bass, a bright arpeggiator running through the verses, warm pad chords, a drum machine with a gated snare and no live drums. A young male tenor sings clean and polished, lifting into an airy falsetto on the hook, with a vocoder doubling the last line. Crisp modern mixing, wide stereo image, shimmering highs. 118 BPM, D major. Bright, slightly melancholy, retro-futurist.
lyrics:
[Intro - Arpeggiator]

[Verse 1]
那個頻率現在只剩雜訊
我還是每天轉到那裡
你說過的晚安在某個地方
應該還在往外走

[Pre-Chorus]
光走了那麼遠都還在
聲音應該也可以

[Chorus]
電波裡的你
沒有變老也沒有離開
只是走得比較遠
遠到我這裡收不到

[Verse 2]
電台頂樓的天線鏽了
他們說沒有人聽了
可是我聽
我一直都在聽

[Synth Solo]

[Chorus - falsetto]
電波裡的你
沒有變老也沒有離開
只是走得比較遠
遠到我這裡收不到

[Outro - vocoder]
晚安
晚安
